div.head: Af 23.1
div.ab: Gif æt ðissa misdæda hwylcre se hund losige, ga ðeos bot hweþre forþ.
Gif æt ðissa misdæda hwelcere se hund losige, ga ðeos bót hwæðre forð.
Si in his forisfactis aliquibus canis perdatur, procedat tamen hec emendatio.
Gif æt ðissa misdæda hwelcere se hund losige, ga ðeos bót hwæðre forð.
If at any of these misdeeds the dog escapes, the compensation is nevertheless applicable.
If the dog disappears after committing any of these offences, this compensation must nevertheless be paid.
If in any of these misdeeds the dog is destroyed, nevertheless this compensation is still to be paid.
Wenn[gleich] bei einer dieser Missethaten der Hund verloren geht, so trete diese Busse dennoch ein.
Even if the dog is lost in any of these misdeeds, let this compensation nevertheless apply.
